title: SC-02 independent asset visual-quality review, final focused repair pass

reviewer.method: Individually inspected current thumbnail/detail images for the four previously blocked assets. Verified all remaining image hashes against pass3; re-inspected the two changed files (sofa-side and treasure-map thumbnail) and found no regression. Fifty-four other current images are byte-identical to previously visually inspected evidence. No implementation source inspected and no metadata/counter used as quality acceptance.

objective: A premium production-quality spatial creative library; recognizable primitive placeholders alone do not satisfy the mandatory geometry/material standard.

sourceIdentity.limitation: Source-bound evidence snapshots/hashes identify the reviewed packet; this is not a frozen committed product candidate.

overall.rationale: The final focused pass resolves the lantern connection, folded-note continuity and rigid-banner findings. The vase decoration remains visibly fragmented. Twenty-nine assets pass bounded rendered-view assessment; the remaining vase prevents complete-catalog visual acceptance. The view pass neither certifies all mandatory production behavior nor grants product journey, hardware or owner acceptance.
overall.repairLoop: Final focused review reached; retain the unresolved finding explicitly rather than repeat automatic quality repairs or relax the standard.

priorFindings.evidence: Current image hashes match pass3 except two re-inspected images without regression.
Current focused images individually inspected; see per-asset observations.
The blue decoration still breaks into sparse dashes, jagged interrupted motifs and segmented bands.

findings.observation: The blue decorative finish remains visibly fragmented in both current supplied views. The previous smooth-profile improvement does not resolve this surface-quality defect.
findings.requiredRepair: Preserve the explicit unresolved limitation. A future correction must provide a clean deliberate surface treatment and matching fresh visual evidence; no further automatic repair loop is proposed in this review.

findings.observation: All reviewed material is exported-asset pipeline evidence. Application library use, actual composed scenes, lighting/effects, authoring and save/reload remain outside this review.
findings.requiredEvidence: Separate actual application capture and independent product journey review.

dimensions.recognizability: All thirty requested categories are represented; the folded-note form remains specifically weak.
dimensions.detailedGeometry: Twenty-nine assets now pass bounded rendered-view assessment, including the focused loop, fold and banner repairs. The remaining vase finish defect blocks complete-catalog visual acceptance.
dimensions.proportions: Broad scale relationships look plausible in isolated views. The open drawer, door, chest and sign views show actual alternative geometry states; real-world/editor placement and behavioral pivots remain unverified.
dimensions.materialResponse: Metal highlights, glass transmission, wood grain, upholstery weave, paper and rug textile character are visible across the packet. The vase blue decoration remains a confirmed unfinished/fragmented surface. Simplified styling is allowed; a broken finish is not waived.
dimensions.normals: No gross missing/inverted face confirmed. Static views under one lighting setup do not establish complete normal/tangent or backface correctness.
dimensions.consistency: Common dark background and stylized color/material language are coherent. Larger views resolve many small-prop detail gaps.
dimensions.distinctiveness: Thirty meaningfully different requested forms are present; map/chart now have different artwork and the two chests have distinct lid construction. Counts are not treated as quality proof.
dimensions.premiumStandard: No full production-complete catalog claim is supported while the vase defect and all separate product/behavior acceptance obligations remain. Twenty-nine bounded view passes must not be relabeled as product or owner acceptance.

capabilityStatus.exportedPipeline: All 64 current images bound by hashes: 10 individually inspected this pass, 54 byte-identical to pass3 images already individually inspected. Actual exported GLB hashes match current manifest.
capabilityStatus.openStates: Door, drawer, articulated chest and wall sign alternate states visually inspected; no interaction/playback correctness claimed
capabilityStatus.performance: OBSERVATION_ONLY: current software WebGL loadAndRenderMs spans approximately 44.5 to 182.8 ms; no editor/device performance, memory lifecycle or repeatability qualification
capabilityStatus.provenance: MANIFEST_DECLARED_ONLY: AI-assisted original geometry, proprietary license, owner authorization required, not published; rights/source provenance not audited in this visual task

limitations: PASS_AT_SUPPLIED_VIEWS is a bounded judgment of the rendered form/material shown. It is not certification of all mandatory model behavior, a premium library completion claim, actual application quality or owner acceptance.
The unresolved vase surface is observed in both current images; no technical cause is asserted from the image alone.
The final repair review retains the blocker rather than reclassifying it as polish or treating counts/load timings as acceptance.
Fifty-four unchanged images are carried forward by exact hash identity; the two changed images outside the focused set were visually re-inspected without a confirmed regression.
All earlier review snapshots and exact evidence are preserved. No implementation files were edited by this reviewer.
